reviewed_clauses.verbatim_extracted_text:
The Zambia Medicines Regulatory Authority (ZAMRA) wishes to officially inform all Marketing 
Authorisation Holders, pharmaceutical manufacturers, importers, and other stakeholders that 
the implementation of the Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between ZAMRA and the 
Egyptian Drug Authority (EDA) has now commenced. 
This collaboration establishes a regulatory reliance mechanism to facilitate the timely availability 
of quality-assured, safe, and effective medicines on the Zambian market. 
 
KEY FEATURES OF THE RELIANCE FRAMEWORK 
ZAMRA will recognise marketing authorisations issued by EDA for medicines manufactured in 
Egypt and approved for the Egyptian market. 
The review and approval process will follow the Recognition Framework for EDA-Approved 
Products developed jointly by ZAMRA and EDA. 
Applications will be processed within 30 working days of submission, provided all requirements 
are met. 
 
REQUIREMENTS FOR APPLICANTS 
Applicants seeking marketing authorisation under this reliance pathway must submit the 
following: 
1) Signed Cover Letter and completed ZAMRA application form 
2) Quality Information Summary (QIS) endorsed and signed by EDA 
3) CTD Dossier as approved by EDA 
4) Labelling information in English (cartons, blisters, inserts, and patient leaﬂets) 
5) A valid cGMP Certiﬁcate issued by EDA 
6) Proof of payment of the prescribed ZAMRA application fees (as per the SI No. 38 of 2016) 
7) Electronic submissions should be sent to:  ៾
៿
᠀
᠁
᠂ ma.reliance@zamra.co.zm (CC: 
foreign.affairs@edaegypt.gov.eg | export@edaegypt.gov.eg)
